value.title: Alwar
value.summary: Alwar (अलवर Alvar), a city of 460,000 people (2018) in Rajasthan, is surrounded by the Aravalli Hills. It was one of the various princely states of Rajputana during the British times.
eat_highlights: Alwar is very famous for milk cake.
